title: Sighting preflight answers 409 for transport failures where the rest of the evaluation request answers 502; docs omit the preflight
outcome:
Two follow-ups to the acceptance sighting preflight.
(1) Transport-class failures of named_root_sighting_read (deadline, dead worker, protocol error, spent budget) map to bad_gateway (502), as acceptance_evaluation_transport_error does for every other tracker transport failure in the request. The semantic refusals stay 409: unsupported operation, incoherent or malformed answer, root mismatch, no sighting.
(2) docs/features/host-architecture.md ("What TermAl calls") lists named_root_sighting_read. docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md (request steps) and docs/architecture.md describe the preflight, its refusals with the remedy wording, and the minimum Engram build that supports the operation (2594b1a).
acceptance: A transport-class failure of the sighting read answers 502 and a semantic refusal answers 409; tests cover both.
host-architecture.md, engram-host-adapter.md and architecture.md document the preflight, its refusals and the minimum Engram build.
